title: DetonationReport
description: Decouples the sandbox orchestrator's internals from the core engine (see docs/SANDBOX.md) — any backend that emits this schema works as an ISandboxProvider. Mirrors compass::core::DetonationReport (src/core/include/compass/core/sandbox.hpp) field for field; this file is the actual wire format the in-guest agent (agent/) writes and QemuTcgSandboxProvider parses.

completed.description: False if the run didn't finish (timeout, crash, agent error) — see `error`.

error.description: Set when completed is false: what went wrong.

executedBlocks.description: Addresses of basic blocks observed to execute. NOT populated by the current agent (strace/tcpdump-based — process/syscall-level, not instruction-level) — would need QEMU TCG plugin instrumentation or a debugger attached (Milestone 5). Left empty rather than fabricated; present in the schema for when that lands.

timestampMs.description: Milliseconds since the traced process started.

callSite.description: 0 — not populated by the current agent (process-level tracing via strace has no visibility into which instruction in the static binary issued the call; see executedBlocks' note). Present for forward compatibility with a future debugger-based agent that can populate it.

argsText.description: Human-readable arguments, as strace formatted them.

bytesSent.description: Not populated by the current agent (tcpdump's text summary reports packet/connection events, not per-connection byte totals); 0 until a pcap-parsing pass is added.
